units.source_text: 古歌：“远方水草多清趣，扰攘都城不可居。”

en.t: An old poem says, "In distant places the water grasses have much pure charm; the bustling capital is no place to live."

units.source_text: 见《古今著闻集》，是玄宾僧都入山修道时所作。

en.t: It appears in the Kokon Chomonju and was composed when the monk Genbin Sozu entered the mountains to practice the Way.
